こんにちは。FFXIVのクサエラというキャラクターの似顔絵をお願いします。彼女は
-ピンクのロングヘア -赤い瞳と赤い縁の輪っか
-明るい肌
-鼻と頬に鱗がある。
-赤いアイシャドウ
-ソフトな赤い口紅

髪の毛はピンクのロングであれば、自由に描いていただいて構いません。服装は黒であれば自由です。
このポーズ[https://i.pinimg.com/564x/0b/e6/29/0be629242888d6b88bc1e78e8c05ef02.jpg]で、目を伏せて真剣な表情をしてほしいです。また、目線は下を向いていて、誰かを嘲笑しているような感じにしてほしいです。
あと、眉毛は濃いめでお願いします。参考画像はこちらです。
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hIx5Pr3xR4gZnNLyrJAXIdABUHb3EXdo?usp=sharing
ありがとうございました。

Would love a drawing of my Raen FFXIV Au Ra character. She has short pink hair, one blue eye and one pink eye, and usually wears pink clothes. She has the wide flat horns by her ears, scales on her cheeks and on her nose. You can pick hairstyle (as long as it's short) and clothes (as long as they're a shade of pink and maybe black or white or gray). I want her to be smiling and looking up, maybe in like a sinister way. Similar to the picture "Azena campfire" in the Google Drive. She is generally a positive helpful person but i would like a darker interpretation of her like she's been disillusioned to all the violence she has seen. Below is the google drive link for her reference pictures.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WyvKxA6LvsZ2aMvMvOHIGP3KAtpGmEe4?usp=sharing
I am not picky so whatever you think looks best :)
